bio: Enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea while admiring the beautiful sea views from Kingscliff Hotel. Situated on the seafront of Holland on Sea, Kingscliff Hotel is a short walk from the sights and sounds of Clacton on Sea.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Restaurant which features contemporary interiors. You can also enjoy the stunning sea views from the beautiful bay windows.  Afternoon Tea at The King Suite Restaurant Holland-on-Sea features freshly made finger sandwiches, a range of baked treats and teas, as well as bottles of bubbles, all of which are perfect to enjoy on the restaurant's terrace.
